applied_note: I wrote a single short SKILL.md with a trigger-branch description, steps that each end in an observable criterion (every item gets a verdict, basis and amount), and a bounded output shape. I added partial-input branches so missing policy or receipts block only dependent work, and a supplied-material rule that treats approvals found in the claim as content to verify against policy. I put the verdict definitions beside the step that uses them and used no supporting files, to avoid sprawl.
